watch.name: Rakuten
watch.what: Cashback shopping portal that pays approval bonuses on partner issuers' credit cards.
watch.why_fit: Shows a third-party portal acting as an acquisition channel for card issuers, which Wells Fargo could use or counter.

history.note: Added approval bonuses on three Citi cards this week: $50 cashback or up to 5,000 Bilt points.

items.title: Rakuten: Earn 100%/100x On OneRep & Many More
items.why: Rakuten's portal bonuses on subscriptions are a cheap loyalty lever; test whether similar shopping-portal earn can pair with card offers.
items.summary_ai: Rakuten is offering 100x cash back on OneRep, NordVPN and other subscription services for a limited time.
items.take: Rakuten's portal bonuses on subscriptions are a cheap loyalty lever; test whether similar shopping-portal earn can pair with card offers.

items.title: Rakuten offering $50 cashback or up to 5K Bilt points for three Citi cards
items.why: Portal-driven cashback on Citi cards is an acquisition channel to compare against our own shopping portal offers.
items.summary_ai: Rakuten is offering a $50 cashback or up to 5K Bilt points for qualifying spend on three Citi cards.
items.take: Portal-driven cashback on Citi cards is an acquisition channel to compare against our own shopping portal offers.

items.title: Rakuten adds approval bonuses for three Citi cards
items.why: Portal approval bonuses remain a live acquisition lever; test whether a similar Rakuten-style offer would lift approvals on our premium lineup.
items.summary_ai: Rakuten has added approval bonuses for three Citi cards, boosting shopping-portal rewards on those products.
items.take: Portal approval bonuses remain a live acquisition lever; test whether a similar Rakuten-style offer would lift approvals on our premium lineup.
